# Open standards schemas

The JSON Schemas the metadata export's ODPS and ODCS documents are validated against in the unit
tests (REQ-2118). Copied unchanged from the Bitol project (Linux Foundation), under the Apache License
2.0 in `LICENSE-bitol`:

- `odcs-json-schema-v3.1.0.json`: Open Data Contract Standard 3.1.0, from
  `bitol-io/open-data-contract-standard/schema/`.
- `odps-json-schema-v1.0.0.json`: Open Data Product Standard 1.0.0, from
  `bitol-io/open-data-product-standard/schema/`.
